name: labs/roesel__elliptec
title: Thorlabs Elliptec shutter (elliptec.Shutter)
intro: Thorlabs Elliptec shutter (elliptec.Shutter), adapted from roesel/elliptec. It reads `is_open`, `is_closed` and `slot`; runs `set_state`, `home_shutter`, `move_to_slot` and `close_shutter`. `set_state`: open or close a mechanical or electronic shutter in the optical path, reporting the resulting state and, for an open shutter, the open duration. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/roesel__elliptec --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/roesel__elliptec --backend fake --mcp
